analysis.reasonEn: After 4 consecutive days of decline, RSI entered oversold territory at 35.0. MACD histogram is worsening at -3.4697, but showing improvement from -1.9144 five days ago. Volume ratio at 1.73, a surge compared to the 5-day average, confirming a slowdown in the downtrend. Current price is at 64.7% of the 52-week low of $118.30. Trading above SMA100 at $304.91 and SMA200 at $239.55.
